# Muhammad Coovadia Psychometrist

> HPCSA Registered Psychometrist in Norwood, Johannesburg. Providing standardized, in-person, paper-based psychometric evaluations for Grade 9 FET subject choices and tertiary/university career guidance.

## Practice Overview

- **Designation**: Registered Psychometrist
- **Statutory Registration**: HPCSA PMT 0104167 | Practice PR 0071253
- **Location**: 84 Frances Rd, Norwood, Johannesburg, 2192, Gauteng, South Africa
- **Testing Format**: Standardized, in-person, paper-based testing batteries (no remote or automated tests)
- **Consultation**: 1-on-1 in-person feedback sessions with parents and students included
- **Billing Policy**: Private practice rates. Full itemised tax invoice provided for medical aid scheme reimbursement (subject to plan benefit coverage)

## Core Assessment Batteries
- [Grade 9 Subject Choice Assessment](https://muhammad-coovadia-psychometrist.vercel.app/assessments/grade-9-subject-choice): Standardized normative evaluation evaluating cognitive aptitude, reasoning skills, and academic/vocational interests to guide FET phase (Grades 10–12) subject stream selection, matric pass rates, and future university Admission Point Scores (APS).
- [Tertiary Field Selection & Career Guidance](https://muhammad-coovadia-psychometrist.vercel.app/assessments/tertiary-field-career-guidance): Comprehensive diagnostic assessment for matriculants, university applicants, and young adults aligning cognitive strengths, abstract thinking, and career affinity with South African university faculties, degrees, and vocational fields.

## Assessment Journey
1. **Initial Intake**: Exploration of candidate's academic and career decision context.
2. **Booking Confirmation**: Scheduling testing session at the Norwood practice room.
3. **In-Person Testing**: Controlled, paper-based psychometric administration in a quiet, distraction-free environment.
4. **Scoring & Interpretation**: Norm-referenced statistical scoring and psychometric analysis.
5. **Feedback & Deliverables**: In-depth written diagnostic report and dedicated 1-on-1 in-person feedback consultation.

## Ethical & Statutory Standards
- Registered under the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA PMT 0104167) and Board of Health Care Funders (PR 0071253).
- Strictly follows HPCSA ethical codes for psychometric assessment, data privacy, and objective normative test interpretation.
- All testing instruments are validated for South African multicultural and multi-lingual normative populations.
- All assessments are strictly in-person, controlled, and paper-based in the Norwood, Johannesburg testing rooms to guarantee test validity and diagnostic integrity.
